نزدحم (form VIII)
# نَزْدَحِمُ (nazdaḥimu) /naz.da.ħi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَحَمَ (izdaḥama)
# نَزْدَحِمَ (nazdaḥima) /naz.da.ħi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَحَمَ (izdaḥama)
# نَزْدَحِمْ (nazdaḥim) /naz.da.ħim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِزْدَحَمَ (izdaḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
